expected_level_description: You can: - advise the board and executive on the organisation's most significant legal risks - give definitive advice on novel, contentious, or high-value matters - set the organisation's appetite for legal risk - assure the quality of legal advice across the organisation, including external advice

You can: - advise the board on the organisation's statutory duties and governance - lead legal work on public inquiries, judicial reviews, and major incidents - shape the organisation's response to new health and care law

You can: - set the organisation's legal position on the use of health and care data - lead on high-risk or novel uses of data, such as research, data platforms, and AI - represent the organisation with regulators on information law

You can: - direct the stakeholder relationship strategy for your teams - ensure stakeholder's objectives are set and support teams to meet them - influence and negotiate with senior stakeholders to resolve issues and enable progress

You can: - change organisational structures to fixable and sustainable designs - lead on the strategy for the whole organisation, marrying business needs with innovative analysis - make and justify decisions characterised by high levels of risk, impact and complexity - build consensus between organisations (private or public) or highly independent and diverse stakeholders - solve and unblock issues between teams or departments at the highest level - understand the psychology of a team and have strong mediation skills - coach the organisation on team dynamics and conflict resolution
You can: - lead managers and shape the culture of a large area - design workforce plans and organisational change - coach leaders and resolve complex people issues
You can: - design the governance framework and advise the board - lead annual governance reporting and assurance
You can: - design the organisation's risk management framework and appetite - advise the board on strategic risks
You can: - hold and manage a budget, forecasting and explaining variances - build a business case with costs and benefits
